newsitem.title: CHINA: Billion Int'l places 100 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Billion Int'l places 100 mln new shares.

text.p: Billion International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it would through a placing agent place 100 million new shares, or 15.6 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$0.52 each to third party investors.
The electronics company said the shareholding of its largest shareholder Ming Kee Investments Ltd would be diluted to 21 percent from 24.9 on completion of the placing on August 29.
The net procceds of about HK$51 million would be used to repay bank liabilities and for general working capital, it said.
The company shares gained HK$0.01 to HK$0.59 in mid-morning.
